news.title: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is back for PSG in the UEFA Super Cup: Georgian missed the World Cup but might just be Europe's best
news.lede: It was heralded as the World Cup in which all the stars shone. But while the big names did indeed illuminate the summer, the return of the club game with the showpiece UEFA Super Cup in Salzburg is a chance for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia to reclaim his spotlight. Kvaratskhelia, 25, was the Champions League player of the season as Paris Saint-Germain successfully defended their crown in May. He returns in August eyeing a threepeat to remind us all that perhaps the best player in Europe was not at the World Cup.

news.title: Infantino accused of killing football in anti-Fifa fan banner
news.lede: Fifa president comes under fire from Lyon ultras as he fights to save his job following failed attempt to sell stakes in World Cup. Gianni Infantino was labelled an “assassin” and Fifa a mafia group on Tuesday night as the fallout from his botched World Cup plan escalated. Members of the Lyon fan group, the Bad Gones, hung an anti-Infantino banner during their Champions League qualifier against Sparta Prague. The banner was unfurled at the Virage Nord inside the Groupama Stadium in France, where Lyon won 3-0 to complete a 4-2 aggregate win.

news.title: NZ Football to send team to U20 World Cup despite calls for Fifa boycott
news.lede: New Zealand Football has committed to sending a team to the Fifa Under-20 Women’s World Cup, despite calls to boycott the competition. The tournament in Poland is the first Fifa competition since Uefa member associations unanimously supported a boycott of events staged by football’s global governing body because of plans by Fifa president Gianni Infantino to sell commercial rights in its competitions to private investors.
